needed.suggestion: Install a proper sidewalk for the left side, ensuring it is clear of obstructions.
Remove obstructions on the sidewalk on the left side to make it fully usable.
Repair or smooth out uneven sections on the right-side footway to prevent tripping hazards.
Install a marked pedestrian crossing to accommodate people crossing the road.
Ensure any crossing facilities are clearly marked and visible to improve safety.
Install a refuge island in the middle of the crossing to allow pedestrians to wait safely.
Implement kerb ramps if a crossing facility is added to improve accessibility.
Enhance street lighting to ensure better visibility for pedestrians and drivers.
